characters.name: Dwight Fairfield
characters.bio: A nervous leader, able to locate his allies and increase their effectiveness.

characters.name: Meg Thomas
characters.bio: An energetic athlete, able to outrun most Killers.

characters.name: Claudette Morel
characters.bio: A studious botanist, able to boost her team's survivability as well as her own.

characters.name: Jake Park
characters.bio: A solitary survivalist, able to hold his own in most situations.

characters.name: Nea Karlsson
characters.bio: An urban artist, able to easily escape and hide.

characters.name: Laurie Strode
characters.bio: A determined Survivor, prepared to weather any challenge.

characters.name: Ace Visconti
characters.bio: A lucky gambler, improving the odds of the entire team.

characters.name: William "Bill" Overbeck
characters.bio: An old soldier, accustomed to dealing with critical situations.

characters.name: Feng Min
characters.bio: An objective-focused competitor who can quickly adapt her strategy to meet a vast range of challenging situations.

characters.name: David King
characters.bio: A rugged scrapper, rewarding high-risk play.

characters.name: Kate Denson
characters.bio: A hopeful songbird, able to make the most of her surroundings.

characters.name: Quentin Smith
characters.bio: A resolute dreamwalker, increasing the survivability and recovery of his team.

characters.name: Adam Francis
characters.bio: A resourceful teacher, able to adapt to new circumstances and develop strategies accordingly.

characters.name: Jeff Johansen
characters.bio: A quiet artist, standing steadfast against impossible odds.

characters.name: Jane Romero
characters.bio: An influential celebrity, going against the grain to tackle challenges head on.

characters.name: Ashley J. Williams
characters.bio: An "alone wolf," cocky and headstrong; a man built for survival.

characters.name: Nancy Wheeler
characters.bio: An aspiring journalist, able to make acute observations and gain insights that others may miss.

characters.name: Steve Harrington
characters.bio: A former jock, able to protect and support his fellow Survivors while providing his own brand of humor.

characters.name: Yui Kimura
characters.bio: A hardened street racer, able to gain advantages for her and her fellow Survivors in challenging situations.

characters.name: Zarina Kassir
characters.bio: A plucky documentarian, able to use her street smarts to avoid detection and greatly assist other Survivors.

characters.name: Cheryl Mason
characters.bio: Cheryl Mason is a young veteran of terror, emboldening both herself and her team.

characters.name: Felix Richter
characters.bio: A visionary architect, able to use his relentless determination to form a plan and help other Survivors.

characters.name: Élodie Rakoto
characters.bio: An occult investigator, able to use cunning tricks and stubborn resolve to keep herself alive.

characters.name: Jill Valentine
characters.bio: Jill Valentine is a founding member of S.T.A.R.S. who has triumphed over countless bio-organic weapons.

characters.name: Mikaela Reid
characters.bio: Mikaela is a young mystic, able to alter the trial with supernatural abilities.

characters.name: Jonah Vasquez
characters.bio: Jonah is a mathematical mastermind, able to use logic to help his team.

characters.name: Yoichi Asakawa
characters.bio: Yoichi is a brilliant marine biologist and psychic whose knowledge and abilities allow him to protect himself and assist others.

characters.name: Haddie Kaur
characters.bio: Haddie is a brave and determined podcaster with the ability to see and feel places of great suffering she calls Overlaps.

characters.name: Ada Wong
characters.bio: Ada Wong is a mysterious secret agent whose skill in espionage makes her a dangerous foe.

characters.name: Rebecca Chambers
characters.bio: Rebecca Chambers is a gifted medic and squad member whose presence soothes those around her.

characters.name: Vittorio Toscano
characters.bio: Vittorio has endlessly wandered through the Fog, attempting to learn its secrets, for ages.

characters.name: Thalita Lyra
characters.bio: Thalita has mastered the art of competitive flair, fighting kites with skill and flourish.

characters.name: Renato Lyra
characters.bio: Renato always keeps his eye on the prize, and he expects the same from his teammates.

characters.name: Gabriel Soma
characters.bio: A resourceful engineer, ready to make the most out of any situation.

characters.name: Nicolas Cage
characters.bio: Nicolas Cage is a superstar, trapped in the role of a lifetime.

characters.name: Ellen Ripley
characters.bio: Ellen Ripley, Warrant Officer of the Nostromo, is capable and pragmatic.

characters.name: Alan Wake
characters.bio: Alan Wake, bestselling author, knows what it means to push back the darkness.

characters.name: Sable Ward
characters.bio: Sable is not afraid to embrace the darkness, or the power that lies within it.

characters.name: Lara Croft
characters.bio: Lara Croft's instincts have been honed by her many dangerous expeditions.

characters.name: Trevor Belmont
characters.bio: Trevor Belmont, vampire hunter, knows his destiny is to vanquish evil.

characters.name: Taurie Cain
characters.bio: Taurie Cain was raised as a Disciple of the Black Talon, condemned to be a sacrifice.

characters.name: Orela Rose
characters.bio: Orela Rose is a paramedic with a love for horror and a calming demeanor.

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.bio: Rick Grimes is the leader of a group of post-apocalyptic survivors.

characters.name: Michonne Grimes
characters.bio: Michonne Grimes is a relentless protector living in a community of post-apocalyptic survivors.

characters.name: Vee Boonyasak
characters.bio: Vee Boonyasak is an energetic drummer whose adventurous nature led to a doomed concert.

characters.name: Dustin Henderson
characters.bio: Dustin Henderson is a brilliant and somewhat nerdy high school student.

characters.name: Eleven
characters.bio: Eleven is a former test subject with extrasensory abilities.

characters.name: The Trapper
characters.bio: An area-control Killer, able to apply pressure across the map by placing deadly Bear Traps for Survivors to step in.

characters.name: The Wraith
characters.bio: A stealth Killer, able to Cloak and Uncloak at the ringing of his Wailing Bell.

characters.name: The Hillbilly
characters.bio: A high-mobility Killer, able to cover large distances in a short amount of time and instantly down Survivors using his Chainsaw.

characters.name: The Nurse
characters.bio: A warping Killer, able to Blink through obstacles and quickly close gaps with her power, Spencer's Last Breath.

characters.name: The Hag
characters.bio: A cursed Killer, able to place traps and then Teleport to them when activated, using her Blackened Catalyst.

characters.name: The Shape
characters.bio: A haunting Killer who stalks Survivors to feed his power.

characters.name: The Doctor
characters.bio: A madness-inducing Killer who is able to use his power, Carter's Spark, to trigger electrical charges, incapacitating Survivors and eventually causing them to hallucinate and scream in terror, revealing their position.

characters.name: The Huntress
characters.bio: A ranged Killer, able to throw Hunting Hatchets at Survivors to injure them from a distance.

characters.name: The Cannibal
characters.bio: A chainsaw-wielding Killer, able to trigger a deadly frenzy using Bubba's Chainsaw, immediately downing anyone in its path.

characters.name: The Nightmare
characters.bio: A nightmare inducing Killer, passively forcing Survivors into his Dream World using his power, Dream Demon. It is here that Survivors become extremely vulnerable to his dream abilities. Using his Dream Projection ability he is able to quickly appear across the map and put pressure on Survivors.

characters.name: The Pig
characters.bio: A tormenting Killer, able to Crouch into stealth mode, then Ambush Survivors from a short distance. She can also apply Reverse Bear Traps to downed Survivors, forcing them to remove it before the timer runs out. If the timer expires, they die instantly.

characters.name: The Clown
characters.bio: A strategic Killer, able to control and corral Survivors by throwing bottles of The Afterpiece Tonic to create clouds of noxious gas that cover large areas for a short amount of time. Survivors Intoxicated by the gas are inflicted with impaired vision and movement speed, and give away their location by coughing loudly.

characters.name: The Spirit
characters.bio: A phase-walking Killer, able to catch Survivors off-guard with her traversal power, Yamaoka’s Haunting. Her power allows her to Teleport from one place to another without being seen.

characters.name: The Legion
characters.bio: A band of merciless Killers, able to rushdown helpless Survivors with their power, Feral Frenzy. Attacks made during their frenzy inflict lingering internal damage, downing any Survivors that are not quick enough to react.

characters.name: The Plague
characters.bio: A devout Killer, able to infect Survivors from a short distance using her power, Vile Purge. Survivors inflicted by this contamination risk becoming injured or broken, unless they find a way to cure themselves in a Pool of Devotion.

characters.name: The Ghost Face
characters.bio: A creepy Killer, able to Stalk his victims and sneak up silently using his power, Night Shroud. Affected Survivors will find themselves vulnerable and oblivious to his presence and must use all of their perception and awareness to protect themselves from his approach.

characters.name: The Demogorgon
characters.bio: An unidentified Killer, able to open multiple Portals and traverse between them to cover large distances. Using its power, Of the Abyss, it can detect any Survivors within a close proximity to the Portals then unleash a leaping attack to inflict damage from a distance.

characters.name: The Oni
characters.bio: A monstrous Killer, able to absorb the blood energy of his injured foes, and then use that energy to transform into a brutal demon. Using his power, Yamaoka's Wrath, he can rush down Survivors at great speed and deal deadly strikes with his kanabō.

characters.name: The Deathslinger
characters.bio: A vengeful Killer, able to spear Survivors from a distance and Reel them in using his power, The Redeemer.

characters.name: The Executioner
characters.bio: A map-manipulation Killer, able to torment Survivors with the hazards he creates. Affected Survivors will be vulnerable to his special hook, the Cage of Atonement, and his unique mori, Final Judgment.

characters.name: The Blight
characters.bio: An unpredictable Killer, able to rush forward in a burst of speed and carom off obstacles to injure Survivors using his power, Blighted Corruption.

characters.name: The Twins
characters.bio: A cooperative pair of Killers, able to divide and hunt together using their power, Blood Bond.

characters.name: The Trickster
characters.bio: A ranged Killer, able to quickly unleash a flurry of blades by using his power, Showstopper.

characters.name: The Nemesis
characters.bio: An unrelenting Killer, capable of attacking at mid-range with his tentacle, while receiving support from Zombies roaming the area.

characters.name: The Cenobite
characters.bio: A summoning Killer, able to possess chain projectiles and use the Lament Configuration to torture every Survivor at once.

characters.name: The Artist
characters.bio: A ranged-reconnaissance Killer, able to launch Dire Crows across the map to reveal and attack Survivors.

characters.name: The Onryō
characters.bio: A vengeful ghost imbued with the power of Nensha, the Onryō is able to silently and invisibly traverse the realm, manifesting when she is ready to strike.

characters.name: The Dredge
characters.bio: A manifestation of the dark thoughts of a once-vibrant community, the Dredge is able to teleport between lockers and summon an overwhelming darkness.

characters.name: The Mastermind
characters.bio: Albert Wesker is a brilliant and ruthless mastermind infused with the power of Uroboros.

characters.name: The Knight
characters.bio: The Knight is a strategic Killer, able to send his faithful Guards to hunt for Survivors and damage objects on the battlefield.

characters.name: The Skull Merchant
characters.bio: The Skull Merchant is a tactical Killer, able to place Drones that detect and debilitate her targets.

characters.name: The Singularity
characters.bio: The Singularity is a relentless Killer, able to launch Biopods to move quickly across the map.

characters.name: The Xenomorph
characters.bio: A relentless specimen from a distant planet, The Xenomorph is vicious, agile, and cunning.

characters.name: The Good Guy
characters.bio: The Good Guy is an elusive Killer, capable of deceiving Survivors with his illusory Footfalls and deadly Slice & Dice.

characters.name: The Unknown
characters.bio: A being beyond understanding, though many have tried.

characters.name: The Lich
characters.bio: Few dare speak The Lich's true name, for fear that he may hear... or worse.

characters.name: The Dark Lord
characters.bio: The Dark Lord, Dracula, is the embodiment of darkness and tragedy.

characters.name: The Houndmaster
characters.bio: The Houndmaster is a force to be feared, with an equally fearsome dog at her side.

characters.name: The Ghoul
characters.bio: The Ghoul has been pushed to his limits and he’s hungry for more.

characters.name: The Animatronic
characters.bio: The Animatronic always comes back.

characters.name: The Krasue
characters.bio: A shape-changing Killer, able to inflict Survivors with an effect that weakens them to her Intestinal Whip attack.

characters.name: The First
characters.bio: The First is a cunning and cruel former test subject, whose powers were sharpened in an alternate dimension.
